you on a journey throughout Lebanon in all its succulent splendor. Renowned for its hospitality and
generosity, the Lebanese culinary experience will introduce you to a whole new way of enjoying food.

## Our promise to you

website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

OUR PROCESS

## Crafted with Intention

[Premium Sesame Seeds]
[Traditional Stone-Grinding]
[Small Batch Production]
[Zero Additives, Ever]
[Shipped Fresh to Your Door]
01

### Premium Sesame Seeds

We source only the finest sesame seeds, carefully selected for their purity, rich flavour, and high
oil content. Every batch is hand-inspected before grinding.

02

### Traditional Stone-Grinding

Our tahini is slowly stone-ground the traditional way cool temperatures preserve natural oils and
nutrients, delivering a depth of flavour that machine processing can't match.

03

### Small Batch Production

We produce in small batches to guarantee freshness and consistency. Every jar receives our full
attention quality over volume, every single time.

04

### Zero Additives, Ever

Just pure sesame seeds. No added oils, no preservatives, no stabilizers. What you see on the label
is exactly what's in the jar — nothing more, nothing less.

05

### Shipped Fresh to Your Door

Every order is packed and shipped within days of production from our Mississauga facility. You
receive tahini at its freshest — never sitting in a warehouse for months.

OUR PROCESS

## Crafted with Intention

[Premium Sesame Seeds]
[Traditional Stone-Grinding]
[Small Batch Production]
[Zero Additives, Ever]
[Shipped Fresh to Your Door]
01

### Premium Sesame Seeds

We source only the finest sesame seeds, carefully selected for their purity, rich flavour, and high
oil content. Every batch is hand-inspected before grinding.

02

### Traditional Stone-Grinding

Our tahini is slowly stone-ground the traditional way cool temperatures preserve natural oils and
nutrients, delivering a depth of flavour that machine processing can't match.

03

### Small Batch Production

We produce in small batches to guarantee freshness and consistency. Every jar receives our full
attention quality over volume, every single time.

04

### Zero Additives, Ever

Just pure sesame seeds. No added oils, no preservatives, no stabilizers. What you see on the label
is exactly what's in the jar — nothing more, nothing less.

05

### Shipped Fresh to Your Door

Every order is packed and shipped within days of production from our Mississauga facility. You
receive tahini at its freshest — never sitting in a warehouse for months.

## Your wholesale & bulk candy supplier for the US & Canada

CandiesWholesaler is a direct importer of European confectionery and a bulk candy supplier in one
place. We bring in sweets straight from Italy, Spain, Belgium, Switzerland, France, Germany and the
Netherlands, then sell them by the case alongside a deep bulk catalog. Browse [imported candy by
country][123], shop [bulk candy by category][124], or work through [wholesale candy by
industry][125] — whichever way you buy.

There’s no membership and no business license required. Anyone can order — retail or wholesale; the
only rule is a 3 kg minimum order (about 6.6 lb), and you’re free to mix any products to reach it.
Buy regularly and it pays to [open a wholesale account][126] for account pricing, Net-30 terms and
faster reordering. New to buying at this scale? Start with [what bulk candy is][127] and the
difference between [bulk and wholesale][128].

## CRX-10*i*A/L Paint

The CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot is the perfect industrial solution for manufacturers new to robotics.
This product line includes the CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot, which precisely dispenses materials for
uniform and reliable application in the paint, liquid and powder coatings, and fiberglass
industries. The CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot is the first and only cobot certified for painting in
accordance with U.S. safety standards and is the best option on the market for precision dispensing
applications.

[ CRX-10iA/L Paint ][134]

## FANUC Accelerates Physical AI in Industrial Robotics, Leveraging NVIDIA Technologies

FANUC is combining its global leadership in robotics with NVIDIA’s AI computing and simulation
platforms to deliver intelligent and adaptable automation. This collaboration integrates ROBOGUIDE
with NVIDIA Isaac Sim and Omniverse to create photorealistic digital twins, and enables robots to
interpret voice commands and automatically generate code.

## Explore the world

Get dropped anywhere from the busy streets of New York to the beautiful beaches of Bali.

## Play with Friends

Put your skills to the test against your friends and family. Create your own private party and play
together.

## Compete against others

Test your ability against players all across the world. Earn badges and compete against others in
tournaments and events!

## World Championship 2026

The GeoGuessr World Championship 2026 is here. Follow players from around the world as they compete
to make it to the World Championship.
[
Read more
][8]

## GeoGuessr for organizations

Looking to play GeoGuessr together with friends, co-workers or in another context? With a GeoGuessr
Pro subscription, you can invite people without subscriptions to play with you in a party or
challenge.
[
Read more
][9]

## Partnerships & Co-labs

We work with a wide variety of partners and co-labs that range from culture, lifestyle, travel,
entertainment, sports, music, education and tech. In this we strive to find that one connection to
explore the world that becomes unique for your purpose, brand or campaign.
[
Read more
][10]
[GeoGuessr]
GeoGuessr ABKatarinavägen 17116 45 Stockholm, Sweden
© 2026 GeoGuessr AB

### Explore

[World Championship '26][11][Organizations][12][Merch][13][Gift cards][14]

### Frequently asked questions

### What is GeoGuessr?

[Show]
GeoGuessr is a geography game, in which you are dropped somewhere in the world in a street view
panorama and your mission is to find clues and guess your location on the world map.

### I have trouble accessing my account.

[Show]
If you've forgot your password, click on "Already have an account?" in the upper right corner, and
then on "Forgot your password?". Enter the email address which is connected to your account, and
we'll send you an email with a link to reset your password! Don't forget to check you spam email if
it may have gotten caught there.
If you are not receiving an email you might have enabled Google/Facebook login. If so, send an email
to [our support team][15] and we will help you further. If you've forgotten which email you signed
up with, no worries! Contact us at [our support team][16] and we'll help you out!

### Is GeoGuessr available on App Store and Google Play?

[Show]
Yes, GeoGuessr is available on iOS and Android, and your account lets you play on the app as well.

### What languages is GeoGuessr available in?

[Show]
GeoGuessr is available in 11 different languages. You can select language in the website footer
under "Change language".

### What is Seterra?

[Show]
Become a geography expert and have fun at the same time! Seterra is an entertaining and educational
geography game that gives you access to over 400 customizable quizzes. Seterra will challenge you
with quizzes about countries, capitals, flags, oceans, lakes and more!
[
Play Seterra now!
][17]

### Business enquiries

[Show]
We'd love to come in contact. To make sure your email gets to the right person, please contact us
at:
Collaborations
If you're an agency, brand, game or content creator who wants to collaborate with us, share your
ideas with [[email protected]][18].
Press/company
For press and other company related enquiries contact our CEO directly at [[email protected]][19].
Press material can be found at [https://design.geoguessr.com][20].
Customer support
If you need help regarding your GeoGuessr account, our support team is ready to help you at
[https://www.geoguessr.support][21].

### Frequently asked questions

### What is GeoGuessr?

[Show]
GeoGuessr is a geography game, in which you are dropped somewhere in the world in a street view
panorama and your mission is to find clues and guess your location on the world map.

### I have trouble accessing my account.

[Show]
If you've forgot your password, click on "Already have an account?" in the upper right corner, and
then on "Forgot your password?". Enter the email address which is connected to your account, and
we'll send you an email with a link to reset your password! Don't forget to check you spam email if
it may have gotten caught there.
If you are not receiving an email you might have enabled Google/Facebook login. If so, send an email
to [our support team][15] and we will help you further. If you've forgotten which email you signed
up with, no worries! Contact us at [our support team][16] and we'll help you out!

### Is GeoGuessr available on App Store and Google Play?

[Show]
Yes, GeoGuessr is available on iOS and Android, and your account lets you play on the app as well.

### What languages is GeoGuessr available in?

[Show]
GeoGuessr is available in 11 different languages. You can select language in the website footer
under "Change language".

### What is Seterra?

[Show]
Become a geography expert and have fun at the same time! Seterra is an entertaining and educational
geography game that gives you access to over 400 customizable quizzes. Seterra will challenge you
with quizzes about countries, capitals, flags, oceans, lakes and more!

# Growjo

## The Fastest Growing Companies w/ Contacts & Emails

# Growjo tracks the fastest growing private companies and startups in the world. Using annual
# revenue, competitor/alternative analysis, “number of employees” growth, funding news, sales &
# financials, valuation increases and other growth triggers, we have created the list below of the
# Top 10,000 companies for the Spring of 2026. Because this list is focused on startups with
# traction, to qualify the company must have between 15 and 1,000 employees. In addition to the
# exportable list below, you can check our contact data for these companies that includes email
# addresses and direct phone numbers. Within the pages you will find quality alternatives to the
# said company as well. Or use our search bar to enrich or [find revenue for private companies][9].
# Growjo also segments lists based on Industry(e.g. [Fintech][10] [AI][11]) and Metro areas (e.g.

We at Jabco Foods are passionate and dedicated importers, wholesaler and distributors of dry foods.
Our areas of expertise are nuts, dried fruits, beans & pulses, spices as well as a whole host of
snack lines. We have been entrusted by several well known and much-loved brands from the MENA region
to handle and market their products into Western Australia.

## Reliable quality

## Partner with excellence

Running a business is stressful enough without having to deal with suppliers that don’t uphold their
promises. At Jabco Foods our word is our bond!

#### Quality Guaranteed

As part of our commitment to food safety, **Jabco Foods** has implemented a Food Safety Program.
Since 2011, Jabco Foods has executed and maintained HACCP standards.

**Jabco Foods** is committed to building a *positive food safety culture* within the organisation.
This culture shall be cultivated by our commitment to providing safe and suitable food and
encouraging appropriate food safety practice.

#### Competitive Pricing

We believe that competitive pricing is the cornerstone of a successful business. We possess both the
capability and the resources to procure Australian-grown products directly from their producers. In
instances where Australian sourcing is not possible, our importation expertise comes into play. With
an extensive network within the global food industry, you can trust **Jabco Foods** to serve as your
exclusive importer, eliminating unnecessary intermediaries. We proudly serve as your gateway to the
world of premium ingredients.

#### Onsite Nut Roasting

The art of nut roasting has been an integral part of our product lineup from day one. Our legacy of
on-site nut roasting spans generations, a testament to our commitment to perfecting this craft. With
premium ingredients and the expertise of our dedicated roasting team, we consistently produce
impeccably roasted nuts, ensuring top-notch quality day in and day out.

#### Experience Matters

At **Jabco Foods**, we’re a family-run enterprise spanning two generations, with a third generation
already in training. We take pride in our role as wholesalers, offering an exceptional selection of
beans, pulses, confectionery, cereals, flours, dried fruits, frozen foods, nuts, herbs, spices, and
snacks. Our special focus is on providing top-notch ingredients for Middle Eastern cuisine

###### Delivering excellence

## Reliable quality

## Partner with excellence

Running a business is stressful enough without having to deal with suppliers that don’t uphold their
promises. At Jabco Foods our word is our bond!

#### Quality Guaranteed

As part of our commitment to food safety, **Jabco Foods** has implemented a Food Safety Program.
Since 2011, Jabco Foods has executed and maintained HACCP standards.

**Jabco Foods** is committed to building a *positive food safety culture* within the organisation.
This culture shall be cultivated by our commitment to providing safe and suitable food and
encouraging appropriate food safety practice.

#### Competitive Pricing

We believe that competitive pricing is the cornerstone of a successful business. We possess both the
capability and the resources to procure Australian-grown products directly from their producers. In
instances where Australian sourcing is not possible, our importation expertise comes into play. With
an extensive network within the global food industry, you can trust **Jabco Foods** to serve as your
exclusive importer, eliminating unnecessary intermediaries. We proudly serve as your gateway to the
world of premium ingredients.

#### Onsite Nut Roasting

The art of nut roasting has been an integral part of our product lineup from day one. Our legacy of
on-site nut roasting spans generations, a testament to our commitment to perfecting this craft. With
premium ingredients and the expertise of our dedicated roasting team, we consistently produce
impeccably roasted nuts, ensuring top-notch quality day in and day out.

#### Experience Matters

At **Jabco Foods**, we’re a family-run enterprise spanning two generations, with a third generation
already in training. We take pride in our role as wholesalers, offering an exceptional selection of
beans, pulses, confectionery, cereals, flours, dried fruits, frozen foods, nuts, herbs, spices, and
snacks. Our special focus is on providing top-notch ingredients for Middle Eastern cuisine

## Krinos Foods, Since 1958

Krinos Foods is the largest importer and distributor of Greek and Eastern European specialty foods
in North America. Since 1958, Krinos has been bringing the finest specialty foods from around the
world to customers’ tables.

[ About Krinos ][62]

## From Farm to Table

Krinos Foods’ carefully selected network of farmers ensures the freshest ingredients for our
products.  

## Markets We Serve

### Ethnic Market

We have a long tradition of serving ethnic food retailers and distributors of all sizes from
industrial scale to mom-and-pop stores.

### Mainstream Market

We partner with national distributors, club stores, and supermarket chains to create custom programs
and product offerings.

### Foodservice

We offer a wide range of international cuisine to restaurants, distributors, and operators in
healthcare, K-12 schools, colleges and universities.

### Private Label

The Olive Packing Company (part of the Krinos family) manufactures and co-packs private label
gourmet olives and specialty products for some of the biggest retail brands.

that sets us apart in the Canadian market.

Source-Direct Supply Chain

better pricing, and full traceability from origin to shelf.

Family Farm in Saudi Arabia

selection for our Saudi date varieties.
iii
Private Label Capability

with our premium products.
iv
Consistent Quality & Supply

stock throughout the year.
v
Canadian Based Distribution
Based in London, Ontario, we serve retailers across Canada with efficient logistics, local support,
and Canadian business reliability.

brands include SADAF, AHMAD TEA, BARTAR, SHAMIM & TAJ FOODS. Carrying over a 1000 sku’s, Minami

– Basmati Rice

– Tea

– Pickles & Condiments

– Over 100 types of specialty Herbs & Spices

– Honey & Jams

– Sugar Cubes & Sweets

– Nuts

– Canned Products

We distribute our products nation-wide to grocery retailers, bulk food stores, cash & carry and
ethnic stores. Throughout the years MINAMI has established itself as one of the leading firms in
this sector of ethnic foods.  The brands and products we offer are sourced from around the world and
represent the leading brands in the ethnic and Middle Eastern market. Furthermore our import team
works continuously to bring you the most authentic goods from around the world including India,
Thailand, Israel, Turkey and the UAE.

## Sadaf Foods

The leading brand in the Middle Eastern Community in North America.

With Over 30 Years in the market, Sadaf Foods has become one of the biggest suppliers and producers
of ethnic food products in North America. Most noteworthy carrying a huge selection of KOSHER
products, this brand is established in many communities as a premium brand with products range of
over 1000 SKU's including Spice, Herbs, Dried & Canned Beans, Tea, Dairy Products, Oil and Pickled
products.

[ View Sadaf Products ][117]

## Ahmad Tea

The most popular Tea Brand in the Middle Eastern community. Distributed in over 80 countries and
carrying over 120 different tea blends. This London Based brand has had great success establishing a
vast market in Russian & Eastern Europe as well and is being enjoyed by tea lovers from different
parts of the world. Ahmad Tea is a must have in any retail store that is aiming to attract ethnic
consumers. Minami is the exclusive distributor of Ahmad Tea in Ontario.

[ View Products ][118]

## TAJ Foods

The Award Winning Ethnic Brand at the SIAL Food show in Toronto 2017 – The most familiar ethnic
brand known to Canadians. For 10 Years TAJ Foods has been sourcing and packaging Persian and Middle
Eastern ingredients and offers them with the highest quality in the Canadian market. Packaged in
Canada, rest assured you will experience the richest authentic flavour with the highest level of
health standards. TAJ Products range includes: Basmati Rice, Specialty Spices, Beans, Dried Fruits,
Sweets & Flavoured Sugar Cubes, Honey and etc.

[ View Products ][119]

## Bartar Foods

With over 300 different types of products, Bartar foods is the leading quality brand in the West
Asian community in Canada. You can rest assure of the originality of our products and enjoy the
great taste of Persian cuisine with Bartar products. The range of products include: Ready meals,
Canned ingredients, Condiments, Pickles, Jams, and Specialty Sweets.

[ View Products ][120]

## DELSTER

The most popular brand of authentic Non-Alcoholic Malt Beverage in Canada! Absolutely 0.00% alcohol.
This product is made in Canada with the highest quality of Malt. Comes in 5 flavours of Classic,
Apple, Lemon & Lime, Peach and Tropical. A great alternative to Beer that the whole family can
enjoy.

### Consistently Smooth, Creamy & Rich Tahini – Crafted for Food Industry Leaders with
### Uncompromising Food Safety

## Great hummus begins with **superior**** tahini**—the heart of its texture, richness, and depth.
## Our **stone-ground, 100% sesame tahini** provides:

[Cream being poured into a ceramic bowl]
* #### A Silky-Smooth Texture
  
  Our tahini is expertly milled for a naturally silky-smooth texture, ensuring effortless blending
  in hummus, halva, and sauces. No grittiness, minimum separation—just pure, creamy perfection in
  every batch.
* #### Naturally Balanced Flavor
  
  Our tahini delivers a naturally balanced flavor—nutty, smooth, and pure, with sweet tastes.
  Perfectly crafted to enhance hummus, halva, and culinary creations without bitterness.
* #### Customizable Roasting & Grinding Levels
  
  Our tahini is tailor-made to match your recipe, with adjustable roasting and grinding levels to
  achieve the perfect flavor, color, and texture for your hummus, halva, and sauces.
* #### Perfect Consistency for Large-Scale Production & Restaurant Kitchens
  
  Designed for manufacturers, restaurant chains, and professional kitchens, our tahini delivers
  smooth, reliable performance in high-volume mixing. Our engineers test every batch, ensuring
  consistency in texture, color grade, and flavor at every stage—from production to final product."
* #### Uncompromising Food Safety & Quality Assurance
  
  Our tahini is produced under the highest food safety standards, with rigorous testing at every
  stage. From raw sesame selection to final packaging, our engineers oversee every step to ensure
  purity, consistency, and compliance with international food safety regulations. With every order,
  you will receive a lab certificate of analysis from both our in-house lab and a third-party
  globally recognized laboratory.

# What Makes Our Tahini Better?

**Crafted with traditional natural white stone-grinding methods, our tahini preserves its rich
flavor and creamy texture—honoring ancient techniques while meeting modern food safety standards.
Every batch is pure, consistent, and made for the finest culinary creations.**
* ## 100% Premium Hulled Sesame Seeds
  
  Expertly Sourced from Long-Standing Partner Farms
  
  [We source only the finest sesame from select farms, ensuring purity and high oil content.]
* ## 100% Pure Sesame
  
  Nothing But Sesame – Clean, Pure, and Natural
  
  [Stone-Ground for Unmatched Smoothness]
* ## Stone-Ground for Unmatched Smoothness
  
  No Industrial Shortcuts – Just Slow Roasting and Gentle Grinding for a Naturally Creamy Finish.
  
  [Close Up / Preparing red meat on the barbecue grill.]

# Bulk Tahini, Crafted for HORECA & Food Manufacturers

## **Our Signature Product: Mystique Tahini**
* **Ingredients:** 100% sesame seeds, no additives.
* **Texture:** Ultra-smooth, rich, and velvety.
* **Packaging Options:** Available in **5kg, 10kg, 17kg, 18kg industrial bulk containers, 215kg
  metal barrels, and 1-ton IBC tanks** to meet various production needs.
* **Shelf Life:** **2 years**
* **Certifications:** **FDA | Organic | Kosher | Halal | BRC | Sedex 4-Pillar**

[Large container of Mystique brand natural tahini with sesame seeds and a cloth beside it.]

**✔ Vegan | ✔ Organic | ✔ Gluten-Free | ✔ Non-GMO | ✔ 100% Natural**

## Trusted infrastructure for industry leading enterprises

For Enterprise IT

## Govern Kubernetes Without the Specialist Tax

Many organizations struggle to operate Kubernetes sustainably. Scarce specialists, massive tooling
ecosystems, and cluster environments sprawling across the enterprise make it difficult to maintain
control over container adoption: placing increasing pressure on governance, security, compliance,
and operational consistency.

This is the enterprise container management problem.

Portainer is the operational control plane that lets enterprise IT teams run Kubernetes and Docker
environments consistently, safely, predictably, and at scale: without depending on Kubernetes
specialists or platform engineering teams.

### Multi-Cluster Fleet Management

Centralized governance across Kubernetes clusters, and Docker hosts. Works with any Kubernetes
distribution: EKS, AKS, GKE, bare metal, or on-premises.

### GitOps Deployment Workflows

Centralized GitOps engine on the Portainer Server: not a controller running inside every cluster.
Promotion workflows from dev to staging to production with rollback, without the overhead of
distributed Argo or Flux installations.

### Self-Service with Guardrails

Enable developers to deploy safely without bottlenecks. Pre-defined templates, resource quotas, and
RBAC enforcement maintain control.

### Enterprise-Grade Identity & Access

Centralized SSO, LDAP, and OIDC integration. Role-based access control designed for real operational
teams with full audit logging.

commitment to premium sesame seeds ensures exceptional taste and consistency. All products are

Packer Brand

tahini products with tailored packaging. From private grocery chains to specialty food brands, we
provide fully branded, market ready tahini solutions. Our advanced production capabilities enable
flexibility in packaging sizes, designs, and labeling. With premium ingredients and cutting-edge
automation, we ensure consistency, quality, and compliance.

## Servet Lezzetlerini Deneyenlerin Yorumları

Fıstıklı helvanın tadı bir harika, inşallah hep aynı kalitede devam eder. Krokanlar da çok iyi,
tahin zaten güzel. Devam... Tahin ve pekmeziniz zaten harikaydı. Şimdi de lokumlarınız, tahin
helvanız ve doğal barlar inanılmaz lezzetli. Hediyeniz için ayrıca çok teşekkürler. İyi çalısmalar
diliyorum. Problemsiz bir şekilde geldi. Ambalajlama harika, şimdiye kadar online satış kanallarında
böyle bir ambalaj görmedim. Bu kadar lezzetli nasıl yapabiliyorsunuz. Sizleri tebrik ediyorum.
Yediğim en lezzetli lokum. İyi ki varsınız. İlk defa alışveriş yaptım ve gerçekten kaliteli ürünler
teşekkürler. Yaaa resmen ben kahve falan içmiyormuşum dedim şu an! Bundan sonra başka kahve içmem.
Hem lezzetli, hem köpüklü. Daha ne isteyebilirim ki. Hayatımda yediğim en güzel pekmez ve tahindi
diyebilirim. İlk defa çifte kavrulmuş tahin aldım harikaydı. Hızlı kargo, sağlam ambalaj ve mükemmel
lezzet. Hayırlı işler diliyorum. Çok lezzetli, özlediğim gerçek balın tadını alabiliyorum. Orjinal
tat, güvenilir içerik, çok temiz ürünler. Tavsiye ediyorum denemenizi. Şeker ilavesiz kaju ezmesi,
fındık ezmesi, krokan ve çifte kavrulmuş tahin aldım. Tadı gerçekten taze lezzetli bir başka güzel.
Mis gibi de kokuyor. Çok lezzetli ve rafine şekersiz böyle bir lezzet! Tekrar tekrar sipariş
edeceğim. Kargo da çok özenliydi. Teşekkürler. Reklamlarda görüp sipariş verdim. Müthiş bir lezzet.
Tatlı sevmeyen insana bile kendini yedirir kıvamda. Paketleme ve kargo kusursuzdu. İşini özenle,
severek yapanların farkı. Unbelievably good!!! Thank you so much! Best tahini ever!!! Kahvesi son
derece hafif ve bol köpüklü. Mide rahatsızlığım olduğu için gönül rahatlığıyla içebildiğim tek
kahve. Gittiğim her yerde yanımda taşıyorum. Veganlar için harika bir tatlı alternatifi. Krokan
genelde sert olur, zor yerim. Bu taptaze ve ağızda dağılıyor bayıldım. Hızlı gönderi ve özenli
paketleme için teşekkür ederim. Tahin ve pekmez inanılmaz lezzetli. Diğer ürünlerinizden de en kısa
sürede sipariş verip deneyeceğim. Aldığım hiçbir üründen pişmanlık duymadım. Gönül rahatlığı ile
tüketiyorum. Şeker ilavesiz olması özellikle aradığım şeydi. Teşekkürler. Lokumlar aşırı iyi. hediye
olarak almıştım çok beğenildi. Yumuşak içim sevenler için ideal. Çok kavrulmuş sevmiyordum ve
aradığım kahve tam olarak bu. Daha önce de alışveriş yaptım. Her bir ürün birbirinden güzel ve
lezzetli... Kalite ve/veya güvenilirlik problemi düşünen varsa düşünmesin alsın derim. Teşekkürler.
Hayatımda yediğim en iyi yer fıstığı ezmesi. Pürüzsüz ve şeker ilavesiz olmasına rağmen lezzeti
mükemmel. 🌸

## Servet Lezzetlerini Deneyenlerin Yorumları

Fıstıklı helvanın tadı bir harika, inşallah hep aynı kalitede devam eder. Krokanlar da çok iyi,
tahin zaten güzel. Devam... Tahin ve pekmeziniz zaten harikaydı. Şimdi de lokumlarınız, tahin
helvanız ve doğal barlar inanılmaz lezzetli. Hediyeniz için ayrıca çok teşekkürler. İyi çalısmalar
diliyorum. Problemsiz bir şekilde geldi. Ambalajlama harika, şimdiye kadar online satış kanallarında
böyle bir ambalaj görmedim. Bu kadar lezzetli nasıl yapabiliyorsunuz. Sizleri tebrik ediyorum.
Yediğim en lezzetli lokum. İyi ki varsınız. İlk defa alışveriş yaptım ve gerçekten kaliteli ürünler
teşekkürler. Yaaa resmen ben kahve falan içmiyormuşum dedim şu an! Bundan sonra başka kahve içmem.
Hem lezzetli, hem köpüklü. Daha ne isteyebilirim ki. Hayatımda yediğim en güzel pekmez ve tahindi
diyebilirim. İlk defa çifte kavrulmuş tahin aldım harikaydı. Hızlı kargo, sağlam ambalaj ve mükemmel
lezzet. Hayırlı işler diliyorum. Çok lezzetli, özlediğim gerçek balın tadını alabiliyorum. Orjinal
tat, güvenilir içerik, çok temiz ürünler. Tavsiye ediyorum denemenizi. Şeker ilavesiz kaju ezmesi,
fındık ezmesi, krokan ve çifte kavrulmuş tahin aldım. Tadı gerçekten taze lezzetli bir başka güzel.
Mis gibi de kokuyor. Çok lezzetli ve rafine şekersiz böyle bir lezzet! Tekrar tekrar sipariş
edeceğim. Kargo da çok özenliydi. Teşekkürler. Reklamlarda görüp sipariş verdim. Müthiş bir lezzet.
Tatlı sevmeyen insana bile kendini yedirir kıvamda. Paketleme ve kargo kusursuzdu. İşini özenle,
severek yapanların farkı. Unbelievably good!!! Thank you so much! Best tahini ever!!! Kahvesi son
derece hafif ve bol köpüklü. Mide rahatsızlığım olduğu için gönül rahatlığıyla içebildiğim tek
kahve. Gittiğim her yerde yanımda taşıyorum. Veganlar için harika bir tatlı alternatifi. Krokan
genelde sert olur, zor yerim. Bu taptaze ve ağızda dağılıyor bayıldım. Hızlı gönderi ve özenli
paketleme için teşekkür ederim. Tahin ve pekmez inanılmaz lezzetli. Diğer ürünlerinizden de en kısa
sürede sipariş verip deneyeceğim. Aldığım hiçbir üründen pişmanlık duymadım. Gönül rahatlığı ile
tüketiyorum. Şeker ilavesiz olması özellikle aradığım şeydi. Teşekkürler. Lokumlar aşırı iyi. hediye
olarak almıştım çok beğenildi. Yumuşak içim sevenler için ideal. Çok kavrulmuş sevmiyordum ve
aradığım kahve tam olarak bu. Daha önce de alışveriş yaptım. Her bir ürün birbirinden güzel ve
lezzetli... Kalite ve/veya güvenilirlik problemi düşünen varsa düşünmesin alsın derim. Teşekkürler.
Hayatımda yediğim en iyi yer fıstığı ezmesi. Pürüzsüz ve şeker ilavesiz olmasına rağmen lezzeti

advisors have decades of hands-on experience working inside production facilities worldwide — giving

### New Lower Prices Terms & Conditions

New Lower Price (“NLP”) items are identified as items currently tagged with a base retail price of
at least 8% or $1 lower than the item’s previous base retail price. NLP classification does not
account for or reflect temporary price reductions, sales, special offers or other item or basket
level discounts of an item which may have been applicable to certain items before or may be
applicable after the NLP classification.
NLP classification varies by Albertsons Companies division and stores but is applied across hundreds
of retail items in a cross-section reflecting many of the main food and merchandise product
categories throughout each participating store. NLP classification may apply only to certain item
and/or brand sizes, flavors or denominations but not others of the same item and/or brand. The
number of items and percentage of total SKUs with NLP classification may change daily with the NLP
tag providing official status for an item. NLP classification is not applied to certain categories
of items, including but not limited to, most alcohol, dairy & egg, floral & gift candy, and vehicle
service (including car wash and gasoline) products as well as in-store and digital service
offerings.
NLP classified items may vary by Albertsons Companies divisions, banners, or stores and are subject
to additional price changes in the course of business. See all NLP classified items by looking
in-store or on-line for any item shown with an official “New Lower Price” tag.

## what is tahini?


Tahini is a creamy, nutritious paste made from ground sesame seeds, an ingredient that dates back
thousands of years to ancient Middle Eastern and Mediterranean cuisines. Traditionally used in
dishes like hummus, baba ghanoush, and halva, tahini has become a pantry staple around the world for
its rich, nutty flavor and silky texture.

[LEARN MORE][50]

## the secret is in the seeds

**We source the highest quality sesame seeds to create a mildly nutty, silky-smooth tahini that's
easy to mix!**

[Soom tahini jars on a colorful tile background with lemons and chickpeas.]

### silky-smooth

We source seeds with a high oil-to-meat ratio and blend them to perfection using age old techniques.
The result is a silky-smooth consistency that can't be beat!

### easy to mix

Because of our premium seeds and special grinding process, Soom tahini separates less than the
others. If you do need to mix, it's quick and easy, unlike those other rock hard brands.

### mild nutty flavor

High quality seeds that are roasted at the right temperatures result in tahini that is mildly nutty
and not overly bitter. Soom tahini brings balance and flavor to any dish!

[
][51]

### big flavor for everyday meals, in one easy squeeze

Tahini has never been this easy, or this flavorful. Made from real, simple ingredients, Soom squeeze
bottles deliver smooth tahini and bold, globally-inspired flavors in one effortless drizzle.

No stirring, no prep, less mess. Just shake, squeeze, and drizzle for faster meals, finished dishes,
and silky sauces in seconds.

[
][52]

### chocolate spreads

just right for recipes or straight from the spoon!

## what is tahini?


Tahini is a creamy, nutritious paste made from ground sesame seeds, an ingredient that dates back
thousands of years to ancient Middle Eastern and Mediterranean cuisines. Traditionally used in
dishes like hummus, baba ghanoush, and halva, tahini has become a pantry staple around the world for
its rich, nutty flavor and silky texture.

[LEARN MORE][50]

## the secret is in the seeds

**We source the highest quality sesame seeds to create a mildly nutty, silky-smooth tahini that's
easy to mix!**

[Soom tahini jars on a colorful tile background with lemons and chickpeas.]

### silky-smooth

We source seeds with a high oil-to-meat ratio and blend them to perfection using age old techniques.
The result is a silky-smooth consistency that can't be beat!

### easy to mix

Because of our premium seeds and special grinding process, Soom tahini separates less than the
others. If you do need to mix, it's quick and easy, unlike those other rock hard brands.

### mild nutty flavor

High quality seeds that are roasted at the right temperatures result in tahini that is mildly nutty
and not overly bitter. Soom tahini brings balance and flavor to any dish!

[
][51]

### big flavor for everyday meals, in one easy squeeze

Tahini has never been this easy, or this flavorful. Made from real, simple ingredients, Soom squeeze
bottles deliver smooth tahini and bold, globally-inspired flavors in one effortless drizzle.

No stirring, no prep, less mess. Just shake, squeeze, and drizzle for faster meals, finished dishes,
and silky sauces in seconds.

[
][52]

just right for recipes or straight from the spoon!

# Touropia Travel

Discover the World
* [Destinations][2]
* [USA][3]
* [Florida][4]
* [Caribbean][5]
* [Europe][6]
* [Mexico][7]
* [Videos][8]

Subscribe for your daily dose of beautiful places you never knew existed 🌎
Subscribe
[[Gallup][Gallup]][9]

## [The Best Way to Experience Native American Culture Might Just Be on Route 66][10]

Here’s a place where the high desert brushes up against history, where ancient traditions and the
legend of Route 66 kind of collide.

[Read More][11]
[[Stone Wings][Stone Wings]][12]

### [Skip that Trip to Mars—This Place in America Looks Just as Surreal][13]

The American Southwest hides places that look more like alien planets than anything you’d expect on
Earth. Out here, time feels frozen in stone.

[Read More][14][[Celebration, Florida][Celebration, Florida]][15]

### [Meet the Florida Town Designed as the Perfect Image of Small-Town America][16]

When you picture a town built from scratch to capture a certain vision of American life, maybe you
see winding streets, inviting front porches, and a community vibe that feels almost too perfect to
be real.

[Read More][17][[Destin Beach][Destin Beach]][18]

### [Skip the Caribbean—This Florida Beach Town Is Every Bit as Stunning][19]

You’ve probably caught a glimpse of those exit signs—the turnoff to one of Florida’s most beloved
beach towns.

[Read More][20][[Albania][Albania]][21]

### [Europe’s Last Truly Undiscovered Country Is Ready to Be Explored][22]

Tucked between rugged mountains and a stretch of turquoise coastline, this country sits quietly,
mostly ignored by travelers.

[Read More][23][][24]

### [Hidden on a Tiny Island in the Mediterranean Is a Forgotten Medieval City][25]

Imagine wandering streets where time’s barely moved in centuries, where honey-colored limestone
walls soak up the Mediterranean sun.

[Read More][26][[John Day Fossil Beds National Monument][John Day Fossil Beds National
Monument]][27]

### [You’d Never Expect to Find a Place Like This in America][28]

Picture yourself in front of hills that look like someone splashed them with watercolors—crimson,
gold, and black streaks wrapping around gentle slopes.

[Read More][29][[Smith Rock State Park][Smith Rock State Park]][30]

### [This State Park Looks Like Utah—But It’s Hundreds of Miles From the Mighty Five][31]

Rising 600 feet above the high desert floor, a canyon carved by an ancient river has turned into one
of America’s most iconic outdoor spots.

[Read More][32][[Sheridan][Sheridan]][33]

### [This Is the Western Town Hollywood Wishes It Could Recreate][34]

Tucked between rolling plains and towering peaks, some small cities manage to hold onto something
you just don’t see much anymore.

[Read More][35][[Dubois][Dubois]][36]

### [Somewhere Between Yellowstone and Jackson Lies a Town That Time Forgot][37]

Tucked away in the far northwest corner of Wyoming, you’ll stumble across a place where the
mountains just shoot up and the wilderness feels like it might never end.

[Read More][38][][39]

### [This Town Has Been Luring New Yorkers North for More Than a Century][40]

Imagine a riverside village where American history and Gothic storytelling meet under big, old
trees. Grand estates perch above the water.

[Read More][41][[New Paltz][New Paltz]][42]

### [One of America’s Oldest Streets Is Hidden in This Charming Hudson Valley Town][43]

Picture a spot where rugged cliffs loom over quiet, historic streets, where you might hike along
mountain ridges in the morning and wander among centuries-old stone houses by afternoon.

[Read More][44][[Lasalle Falls][Lasalle Falls]][45]

### [This State Park’s Waterfall-filled Canyons Feel Almost Impossible in the Midwest][46]

This place stands out—almost defiantly—against the endless prairie that surrounds it, and you really
can’t miss the contrast.

[Read More][47][[Geneva][Geneva]][48]

### [Just Outside Chicago Lies One of the Midwest’s Most Beautiful Downtowns][49]

You’ve probably passed through dozens of small towns along a river, but a few still manage to hold
onto their historic character and keep things genuinely lively.

[Read More][50][[Many Glacier Hotel Seats][Many Glacier Hotel Seats]][51]

### [The Historic Lodge Built to Convince Americans They’d Found the Alps][52]

Imagine rolling out of bed to see glacier-carved peaks mirrored in a glassy alpine lake.

[Read More][53][[Lookout Studio][Lookout Studio]][54]

### [This Century-Old Landmark Comes With One of the Most Spectacular Views on Earth][55]

Perched right on the edge of one of the world’s most jaw-dropping natural wonders, some buildings
just seem to grow straight out of the rock.

[Read More][56]

### World Population

retrieving data...
[Current World Population][52]
[+] [–]

World Population:

Updated with the [2024 United Nations Revision][53]
* reached 8 billion in 2022, according to United Nations estimates.
* is projected to reach 9 billion in 2037, and 10 billion in 2060.
* has doubled in 40 years from 1959 (3 billion) to 1999 (6 billion).
* is currently (2025) growing at a rate of around 0.85% per year, adding around 70 million people
  per year to the total.
* growth rate reached its peak in the late 1960s, when it was at 2.09%.
* growth rate is currently declining and is projected to continue to decline in the coming years
  (reaching below 0.50% by 2047, reach 0 in 2084, and decline by -0.12% in 2100) .
* a tremendous change occurred with the industrial revolution: whereas it had taken all of human
  history up to the year 1800 for world population to reach 1 billion, the second billion was
  achieved in only 130 years (1930), the third billion in 30 years (1960), the fourth billion in 15
  years (1974), the fifth billion in 13 years (1987), the sixth billion in 11 years (1998), the
  seventh billion and eighth billion in 12 years each (2010 and 2022). During the 20th century
  alone, the population in the world has grown from 1.65 billion to 6 billion.

Sources for the world population counter:
* [World Population Prospect: the 2024 Revision][54] - United Nations, Department of Economic and
  Social Affairs, Population Division (2024)
* [International Programs Center at the U.S. Census Bureau, Population Division][55]

For more detailed information:
* [World Population][56] (Worldometer)

World Population:

Updated with the [2024 United Nations Revision][53]
* reached 8 billion in 2022, according to United Nations estimates.
* is projected to reach 9 billion in 2037, and 10 billion in 2060.
* has doubled in 40 years from 1959 (3 billion) to 1999 (6 billion).
* is currently (2025) growing at a rate of around 0.85% per year, adding around 70 million people
  per year to the total.
* growth rate reached its peak in the late 1960s, when it was at 2.09%.
* growth rate is currently declining and is projected to continue to decline in the coming years
  (reaching below 0.50% by 2047, reach 0 in 2084, and decline by -0.12% in 2100) .
* a tremendous change occurred with the industrial revolution: whereas it had taken all of human
  history up to the year 1800 for world population to reach 1 billion, the second billion was
  achieved in only 130 years (1930), the third billion in 30 years (1960), the fourth billion in 15
  years (1974), the fifth billion in 13 years (1987), the sixth billion in 11 years (1998), the
  seventh billion and eighth billion in 12 years each (2010 and 2022). During the 20th century
  alone, the population in the world has grown from 1.65 billion to 6 billion.

[Fındıklı Krema Çeşitleri][41] Zirve Gıda Joynut kakaolu fındıklı-püreli ve parçacıklı krema çeşitleri, gıda endüstrisindeki oteller, pastaneler ve restoranlar gibi büyük gıda sektörlerinde yaygın bir kullanım alanına sahiptir. [ [Fındıklı Krema Çeşitleri] ][42] [Pralin Çeşitleri][43] Zirve Gıda'nın Joynut kakaolu-beyaz-gold-chokobake pralin dolgu malzemeleri, gıda endüstrisinde müşteri memnuniyeti konusunda güvenilir bir seçenek sunar. [ [Pralin Çeşitleri] ][44] [ [Waffle Sosları] ][45] [Waffle Sosları][46] Zirve Gıda, bitter-fildişi-sütlü waffle sosları ve muz-çilek-frambuaz-antep fıstığı-limon-böğürtlen aromalı waffle sosları ile endüstriyel gıda sektörüne eşsiz bir tat deneyimi sunar. [ [Dondurma Sosları] ][47] [Dondurma Sosları][48] Zirve Gıda'nın dondurma sosları, endüstriyel gıda üreticileri ve dondurma sektörü için pratik ve kolay kullanıma sahip, önemli bir avantaj sağlar. [Tahinli Krema Çeşitleri][49] Zirve Susam Tahin Attariye'nin tahinle enfes bir uyum yakalamış kremalı lezzetlerini keşfedin! Zirve Sesamel tahinli krema çeşitlerimiz, gıda endüstrisinin ihtiyaçlarını karşılamak için susam tahin kreması, toptan tahin ve susam gibi ürünler sunar. [ [Tahinli Krema Çeşitleri] ][50] [Çikolata Dekorasyon Çeşitleri][51] Zirve Gıda çikolata dekorasyon çeşitleri, Damla drop bitter-sütlü-fildişi-frambuaz, Parça çikolata bitter ve sütlü, Konfiseri bitter-sütlü-fildişi ve Çakıltaşı ürünleri geniş bir yelpazede endüstriyel gıda sektörünün ihtiyaçlarını karşılamak üzere özenle tasarlanmıştır. [ [Çikolata Dekorasyon Çeşitleri] ][52] [ [Dolgu Çeşitleri] ][53] [Dolgu Çeşitleri][54] Zirve Gıda dolgu çeşitleri ısıya dayanıklı özelliği ile limon-portakal-böğürtlen-çilek-meyve parçacıklı ve meyve aromalı çeşitlerinin yanında, kakaolu fındıklı-krokantlı fındıklı-tahinli krema-kakaolu ve beyaz pralin çeşitleri ile şekerleme gibi gıda endüstrilerinde sıkça tercih edilmektedir. [ [Endüstriyel Çeşitleri] ][55] [Endüstriyel Çeşitleri][56] Zirve Gıda'nın endüstriyel çeşitleri, pastacılık, unlu mamuller, soslar, çorbalar ve birçok gıda ürününde çeşitli kullanım kolaylığı sağlar. Alkalize-naturel kakao tozları, pudra şekeri, mısır-buğday nişastası, Alemdar 07-621 ürünleri ile gıda endüstrisinde geniş bir yelpazeye sahiptir. Ürünler Kalite ve zamanında hizmet anlayışını kendimize ilke edinerek sizler için en lezzetli ürünleri üretiyoruz. Artan taleplere cevap vermek için 1976 yılında yeni yerine taşınarak faaliyetlerine devam etmiştir. 2001 yılında ülkemiz ve dünya ekonomik ve ticari şartlarını değerlendiren şirket kurucularımız, ﬁrmamızın ana üretim modelinin “susam işleme, çikolata ve tahin üretimi” olmasını benimsemiş, hizmet edilecek dost sektörleri ise “tahin, tahin helvası, unlu mamuller, şekerleme ve bisküvi üreticileri” olarak belirleyerek ZİRVE SUSAM TAHİN ATTARİYE GIDA SANAYİ TİCARET LİMİTED ŞİRKETİNİ kurmuşlardır. [İncele][36] Ürün Kategorileri Geniş ürün yelpazemizle sektörün ihtiyaçlarına uygun çözümler sunuyoruz. [ [Tahin Çeşitleri] ][37] [Tahin Çeşitleri][38] Zirve Gıda, çifte kavrulmuş tahin ve diğer tahin çeşitleriyle gıda sektöründeki müşteri ihtiyaçlarını karşılamayı amaçlayarak güvenilir ve kaliteli endüstriyel ürünler sunar. [ [Susam Çeşitleri] ][39] [Susam Çeşitleri][40] Zirve Gıda, endüstriyel gıda sektörlerinin ihtiyaçlarını karşılamak amacıyla simit, makarnalık, bisküvilik, tahin, çifte kavrulmuş, sortex ve lokum susam çeşitleri gibi çözümler sunar. [Fındıklı Krema Çeşitleri][41] Zirve Gıda Joynut kakaolu fındıklı-püreli ve parçacıklı krema çeşitleri, gıda endüstrisindeki oteller, pastaneler ve restoranlar gibi büyük gıda sektörlerinde yaygın bir kullanım alanına sahiptir. [ [Fındıklı Krema Çeşitleri] ][42] [Pralin Çeşitleri][43] Zirve Gıda'nın Joynut kakaolu-beyaz-gold-chokobake pralin dolgu malzemeleri, gıda endüstrisinde müşteri memnuniyeti konusunda güvenilir bir seçenek sunar. [ [Pralin Çeşitleri] ][44] [ [Waffle Sosları] ][45] [Waffle Sosları][46] Zirve Gıda, bitter-fildişi-sütlü waffle sosları ve muz-çilek-frambuaz-antep fıstığı-limon-böğürtlen aromalı waffle sosları ile endüstriyel gıda sektörüne eşsiz bir tat deneyimi sunar. [ [Dondurma Sosları] ][47] [Dondurma Sosları][48] Zirve Gıda'nın dondurma sosları, endüstriyel gıda üreticileri ve dondurma sektörü için pratik ve kolay kullanıma sahip, önemli bir avantaj sağlar. [Tahinli Krema Çeşitleri][49] Zirve Susam Tahin Attariye'nin tahinle enfes bir uyum yakalamış kremalı lezzetlerini keşfedin! Zirve Sesamel tahinli krema çeşitlerimiz, gıda endüstrisinin ihtiyaçlarını karşılamak için susam tahin kreması, toptan tahin ve susam gibi ürünler sunar. [ [Tahinli Krema Çeşitleri] ][50] [Çikolata Dekorasyon Çeşitleri][51] Zirve Gıda çikolata dekorasyon çeşitleri, Damla drop bitter-sütlü-fildişi-frambuaz, Parça çikolata bitter ve sütlü, Konfiseri bitter-sütlü-fildişi ve Çakıltaşı ürünleri geniş bir yelpazede endüstriyel gıda sektörünün ihtiyaçlarını karşılamak üzere özenle tasarlanmıştır. [ [Çikolata Dekorasyon Çeşitleri] ][52] [ [Dolgu Çeşitleri] ][53] [Dolgu Çeşitleri][54] Zirve Gıda dolgu çeşitleri ısıya dayanıklı özelliği ile limon-portakal-böğürtlen-çilek-meyve parçacıklı ve meyve aromalı çeşitlerinin yanında, kakaolu fındıklı-krokantlı fındıklı-tahinli krema-kakaolu ve beyaz pralin çeşitleri ile şekerleme gibi gıda endüstrilerinde sıkça tercih edilmektedir. [ [Endüstriyel Çeşitleri] ][55] [Endüstriyel Çeşitleri][56] Zirve Gıda'nın endüstriyel çeşitleri, pastacılık, unlu mamuller, soslar, çorbalar ve birçok gıda ürününde çeşitli kullanım kolaylığı sağlar. Alkalize-naturel kakao tozları, pudra şekeri, mısır-buğday nişastası, Alemdar 07-621 ürünleri ile gıda endüstrisinde geniş bir yelpazeye sahiptir. Ürünler Kalite ve zamanında hizmet anlayışını kendimize ilke edinerek sizler için en lezzetli ürünleri üretiyoruz.
